description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 55 - Directing all Manufacturers and Traders, that they shall be marked the Maximum Retail Price etc. on the items such as Ata Pirikara etc w.e.f. 01.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, specifying regulatory requirements for manufacturers and traders regarding product labeling. It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements established by statute.
